paper_record.title: Pseudospin Hall Transport Induced by Berry Curvature
paper_record.abstract: Pseudospin-1 Dirac systems exhibit unique physics distinct from conventional Dirac cones, such as flat-band crossings and non-Abelian characteristics, yet their topological transport properties have remained largely untapped in passive, time-reversal-invariant settings. Here we uncover an in-plane polarity of the Berry-curvature texture in a pseudospin-1 Dirac Hamiltonian, a previously unexplored geometric degree of freedom encoded in the sign-resolved distribution of Berry curvature despite zero net Berry flux, and reveal a new mechanics where Berry curvature induce pseudospin Hall behaviors in a system. We show that the oriented coupling between this momentum-space polarity and a real-space mass gradient governs a geometric selection rule that dictates the emergence of gapless pseudospin Hall modes. By engineering the intracell couplings of a four-site planar lattice, we independently program the Berry-curvature polarity and the spatial mass gradient without altering the host lattice symmetry. Acoustic experiments directly confirm this directional selection rule: reversing the mass gradient closes or reopens the dispersive gap, while pseudospin-selective source excitation launches counterpropagating pseudospin branches along arbitrary prescribed axes. Our work establishes quantum geometric polarity as a versatile tool for reconfigurable wave routing, sensing, and high-capacity quantum applications.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 研究揭示了伪自旋-1狄拉克系统中的贝里曲率极性，并利用其与空间质量梯度的耦合实现了可重构的伪自旋霍尔波导。
one_sentence_summary.en: The study uncovers Berry-curvature polarity in pseudospin-1 Dirac systems and demonstrates reconfigurable pseudospin Hall waveguiding through its coupling with spatial mass gradients.

problem.zh: 伪自旋-1狄拉克系统在被动、时间反演不变的设置中，其拓扑输运性质尚未得到充分开发，且通常缺乏鲁棒的定向拓扑通道。
problem.en: The topological transport properties of pseudospin-1 Dirac systems remain largely untapped in passive, time-reversal-invariant settings, typically lacking robust directional topological channels.

approach.zh: 通过四位平面声学晶格，独立调控胞内耦合以编程贝里曲率极性，并结合空间质量梯度设计，利用几何选择规则实现伪自旋霍尔效应。
approach.en: Using a four-site planar acoustic lattice to independently program Berry-curvature polarity via intracell couplings, combined with spatial mass gradient engineering to realize pseudospin Hall effects via a geometric selection rule.

main_takeaway.zh: 贝里曲率极性与空间质量梯度的定向匹配构成了一种几何选择规则，可决定无间隙伪自旋霍尔模式的产生及传播方向。
main_takeaway.en: The oriented matching between Berry-curvature polarity and a real-space mass gradient establishes a geometric selection rule that dictates the emergence and propagation direction of gapless pseudospin Hall modes.

why_it_matters.zh: 该机制为在不改变物理边界的情况下实现可重构的波导、传感及高容量量子应用提供了一种通用的几何调控工具。
why_it_matters.en: This mechanism provides a versatile geometric tool for reconfigurable wave routing, sensing, and high-capacity quantum applications without altering physical boundaries.

reason.zh: 该工作在伪自旋-1系统中发现了一种新的几何自由度，并成功将其转化为可编程的拓扑输运控制手段。
reason.en: The work identifies a new geometric degree of freedom in pseudospin-1 systems and successfully translates it into a programmable means of controlling topological transport.

reason.zh: 该论文结合了深刻的拓扑物理机制与高质量的声学实验验证，符合顶级物理期刊的发表标准。
reason.en: The paper combines profound topological physical mechanisms with high-quality acoustic experimental validation, fitting the standards of top-tier physics journals.
